messages.author: Thomas Gaillard
messages.body:
Dear AMBER developers and users,
I was wondering what is the use of the TREE_CHAIN_CLASSIFICATION
parameter of the prmtop. Can it be safely modified or does it have an
impact on the calculations?
I would indeed like to use this field as a selection flag, to be able to
define arbitrary selections for restraints, as suggested by Jason Swails
in message 201501/0325 of the mailing list, with something like:
FIND
* * X *
SEARCH
Thank you for your help.
Best regards,
--

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Fri, Mar 20, 2020, Thomas Gaillard wrote:
>
>I was wondering what is the use of the TREE_CHAIN_CLASSIFICATION
>parameter of the prmtop. Can it be safely modified or does it have an
>impact on the calculations?
>I would indeed like to use this field as a selection flag, to be able to
>define arbitrary selections for restraints, as suggested by Jason Swails
>in message 201501/0325 of the mailing list, with something like:
I'm pretty sure that nothing depends on this; in sander, the only place
I see the information used is in calls to rgroup(), that is, as input
data to atomic selection. So, if you modified the TREE_CHAIN info, and
then used that in a search criteria, that ought to work.
...good luck....dac
